## Summary

Describe the narrow behavior or maintenance change.

## Validation

- [ ] CI passes.
- [ ] I added or updated synthetic regression tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I tested the intended result and core app behavior on a non-critical profile/device when applicable.
- [ ] I recorded relevant Surge, OS, app, module, and release/tag versions without device or account identifiers.

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, cookies, tokens, account data, signed-in traffic, device identifiers, LAN inventory, or raw packet/request captures.
- [ ] Executable scripts are authored in this repository and do not dynamically load third-party code.
- [ ] Any generated-rule changes include reviewed source hashes, rule counts, and diffs, and preserve upstream licensing information.
- [ ] Account, payment, purchase validation, sync, upload, and unrelated application behavior remain unchanged.
